text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right, I see it! Hanshin Racecourse. 
Ready to roll in, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's finally time for your Make 
Debut.

Yeah, it's finally time for your Make 
Debut.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Everyone, are you ready?!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oooh!
choice_data_list:
Why did all of you come all the way to 
Hanshin...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! What a foolish question. As if I'd 
ever miss such an important maiden 
voyage!"

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Tap wouldn't survive on her 
own... She forgets things constantly, and 
replaces meals with snacks."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's right! Looking after me is 
your job. Countin' on ya!

At first glance, she's a dependable 
leader. Yet behind the scenes, it seems 
there's another side to her—one supported 
by her friends.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn* Not being able to lie down on the 
night bus was so rough~. And it took a 
toll on my wallet too~

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sorry~. We can't really let people who 
aren't related to the academy ride the 
Tracen bus~.

A high schooler's pockets aren't deep. 
Even so, she emptied out her allowance to 
rush out to the venue and support me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this paper... Is this today's 
strategy?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's the estimated lap time.
Yeah, that's the projected lap time.

text_block_list.text:
Predictions are just predictions, and 
things won't necessarily go as planned. 
Still, I wanted her to run at a pace as 
close to ideal as possible.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Great! Well done. With your strategy and 
my charging power—we can do this!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I-I can hear it! From the far end of the 
tunnel... Cheers calling out to me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is looking great! Let's blow 'em away 
right from our debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hyahoo! Yeah!!

Tap Dance City dances with high spirits. 
I'm worried about wasting stamina, but—

Her acting up was already anticipated. If 
it's only this much, it shouldn't cause 
problems in the race...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, look at the size of this audience!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Tap, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Oooh, everyone—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hyahoo! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Dance, dance, daaance! I'll show every 
single one of you a dream!"

To some extent, it's factored in. Yet the 
atmosphere of the Twinkle Series gets me 
abnormally pumped up.

Tap Dance City can usually keep herself 
under control reasonably well, but 
today...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Guess that's enough for a warm-up. 
Now, to continue—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"On the course! Let's do it on the course! 
Out on our first vast ocean of rolling 
waves!"
